text: V1 for Cinder Labs has to be scoped honestly -- what EmberStake actually ships, and what it deliberately doesn't.
V1 ships EmberStake.sol, its test suite, a real internal audit, an indexer/API, and a mainnet deployment.
V1 does not build an NFT marketplace or a DAO governance system -- real ideas, deliberately deferred.
V1 also doesn't rebuild $EMBER itself -- it's already a deployed, working ERC-20 token.
Next: choosing the actual tech stack -- Solidity, Hardhat, OpenZeppelin, and Base.
